## Versions

The support matrix: which version of each platform and framework OneSim targets and is tested against. The
source is [versions.json](versions.json); this table is generated from it.

<!-- versions:start (generated by scripts/api-coverage.mjs) -->
| Target | Version | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| iOS Simulator runtime (default) | 27.2 (24B8117), iPhone 18 Pro | Reference screenshots in `tests/fixtures/ios27`, look of the renderer (`--ios 27.2`), OS version the Expo guest reports |
| iOS Simulator runtime | 26.5 (23F77), iPhone 17 Pro | Reference screenshots in `tests/fixtures`, look of the renderer (`--ios 26.5`), OS version the Expo guest reports |
| iOS SDK (Xcode) | 27.2 | SwiftUI API inventory (`scripts/swiftui-inventory.mjs`) |
| Expo SDK | 58.0.26 (React Native 0.88.1, Expo UI 58.0.29) | Examples, native module contracts |
| Expo Go | iOS 58.0.7, Android 58.0.5 | Expo reference screenshots |
| Jetpack Compose | runtime 1.13.0-beta01, ui 1.13.0-beta01, ui-graphics 1.13.0-beta01, ui-text 1.13.0-beta01, ui-unit 1.13.0-beta01, ui-geometry 1.13.0-beta01, ui-tooling-preview 1.13.0-beta01, foundation-layout 1.13.0-beta01, foundation 1.13.0-beta01, animation-core 1.13.0-beta01, animation 1.13.0-beta01, material3 1.5.0-beta01, navigation-compose 2.10.0-rc01, activity-compose 1.13.0-rc01 | Compose API inventory (`scripts/compose-inventory.mjs`) |
| Android | Android 17 (API 37) emulator, Pixel 10a; Kotlin 2.4.21 | Expo and Compose device profile, Compose guest compiler (`frameworks/compose/scripts/toolchain.sh`) |
<!-- versions:end -->

`node scripts/api-coverage.mjs --check` (CI) fails when something pinned in the repo disagrees with the matrix:
an example's `expo` / `react-native` version, the iOS version the Expo guest reports (`osVersion`, `systemVersion`,
user agent in `frameworks/react-native/guest/modules.js`), or a reference-screenshot README under `tests/fixtures/`
that names another iOS runtime or Expo Go version. The inventory scripts write the SDK and library versions they
read into the matrix.

Policy: support the current and previous major of each target (iOS 26 and 27, the latest two Expo SDKs), each
pinned to one release. A point release is not tracked unless it changes behaviour or the look.

Upgrading a target (new iOS, Expo SDK or Compose release):

1. Regenerate the API inventory (`scripts/swiftui-inventory.mjs`, `scripts/compose-inventory.mjs`); for Expo,
   bump the examples and diff the native module specs between SDKs. New APIs land as ⬜ rows.
2. Capture new reference screenshots on the new runtime (see each fixture README).
3. Run the pixel-diff gates (`scripts/compare-ios.sh`, also with `SIMCORE_FALLBACK=1`). Where the new version
   looks different, the renderer needs a per-version override; keep the old version passing too.
4. Update [versions.json](versions.json) and run `node scripts/api-coverage.mjs`; `--check` lists anything
   still pinned to the old version.

## Maintenance

Refresh the summaries with `node scripts/api-coverage.mjs`; CI runs it with `--check`. New frameworks (Charts,
MapKit, … per the [roadmap](../roadmap.md#apple-frameworks-beyond-swiftui)) get their own folder and an entry in
`FRAMEWORKS` in that script.
